messages:
Maya (CS): quick weekly VPC health snapshot for Aurelia Health — please read and flag blockers
Maya (CS): TL;DR: overall serving OK, but a couple of regional regressions this week: us-east-1 increased latency 95p -> 220ms, ap-southeast-2 KMS latency spikes + intermittent HSM auth failures, eu-west-1 stable.
Maya (CS): attaching the short checklist: usage trends, p99 latency, 500s by region, kms errors, outstanding action owners.
Anya (Solutions): got it. do we have a customer-facing note to send if we need to communicate transient KMS flakiness?
Kevin (DevEx): we should avoid customer panic — recommended internal note first. If KMS incidents exceed 30 mins in a region, escalate to SOC and CS draft a proactive message.
ops-bot: Incident detected: KMS-auth-failures ap-southeast-2 at 2026-03-19T09:14Z (count 42) :raised_eyebrow:
Jin (Eng-Infra): pinged HSM vendor; initial telemetry shows elevated auth latency around 09:10-09:35 UTC, likely connection retries from HSM cluster node b.
Maya (CS): region breakdown:
us-east-1: 3% error rate this week (up from 0.3%), rolling p50->p95 latency shift. visible on model-route rn/llama-2-13b.
eu-west-1: green, multi-AZ healthy, no KMS errors.
ap-southeast-2: KMS auth failures intermittent, 500s on dedicated pools during short windows; customer reported 15 failed inference requests last night.
Anya (Solutions): onboarding progress: Aurelia's private env is ~85% configured, they hit the KMS issue during first end-to-end test yesterday — blocked on key rotation test.
Kevin (DevEx): checklist items for this thread:
- collect request IDs for failed calls (Maya)
- escalate HSM vendor (Jin)
- review autoscaling behavior during spike (Kevin)
- prep customer note if >30m (Anya)
Maya (CS): I'll pull the failed request IDs and add examples to the support ticket.
Jin (Eng-Infra): HSM vendor says they'll rotate a failover node at 10:30 UTC. I'll schedule a short maintenance window; will post runbook steps after rotation.
Anya (Solutions): suggest we run a small replay against a staging KMS endpoint after rotation, confirm auth success, then mirror to prod.
Kevin (DevEx): set temporary routing policy: route new requests from Aurelia to eu-west-1 regional fallback for non-data-residency-sensitive paths. Add rule in routing policy:
```
route: if region==ap-southeast-2 and kms_state != healthy then fallback_region=eu-west-1
```
Maya (CS): vendor rotation completed at 10:31 UTC per Jin. observed auth latency drop in ap-southeast-2 within 6 minutes.
ops-bot: Metrics update: ap-southeast-2 KMS-auth-errors reduced to baseline at 10:38 UTC.
Jin (Eng-Infra): post-rotation notes: node b had stale certs causing periodic TLS renegotiation. vendor cleared cert chain and we validated. action: vendor to send cert expiry report weekly.
Anya (Solutions): I'll hold on customer comms until we confirm a clean 24h window, but will send a brief advisory to the Aurelia technical contact: one-line summary + reassurance.
Maya (CS): Renewal risk note: low today but if we see repeat outages in next 2 weeks during onboarding we should flag to AMs.
Kevin (DevEx): one ops tweak: add a short synthetic KMS auth every 5m from each region to catch regressions earlier. I can PR the check.
Maya (CS): outstanding owners: Maya -> collect request IDs & customer examples; Jin -> confirm vendor cert report cadence; Kevin -> PR synthetic check & routing rule; Anya -> draft customer advisory if needed.
Jin (Eng-Infra): added runbook snippets to infra-runbooks/kms-hsm-failover (internal link).
Maya (CS): thanks. I'll update the weekly account health doc and ping AMs if anything changes.
Anya (Solutions): noted, will coordinate the advisory template.
Kevin (DevEx): leave a :thumbsup: if resolved for you; otherwise we'll reconvene in 24h.
Maya (CS): :thumbsup: for now. closing loop in 24h unless new incidents.
